dict.string: A fourth specialization for seven vanilla classes: the Stormbringer Ranger, the Invocation Wizard, the Arcane Sorcerer, the Winddancer Rogue, the Bannerlord Warrior, the Branding Warlock and the Devil Forgemaster Priest (raise the dead you aim at, bosses included). Each has a new active skill, a new passive and their orbs. Part of HammerwatchPlus; requires HWP Core.
